items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: a lot of the scores that I did Thad and Mel did

ctx.x: Last night what else did he do?

'Don't Misunderstand,' and -- there was a blues thing. He recorded it with Thad Jones's band, because a lot of the scores that I did Thad and Mel did. Oh, it was a blues. Gee whiz, I can't even think of that now. You know, when you get -- Pat, when you get piles of music it's hard to remember.
Did you say earlier that you did an arrangement on, 'In the Beginning God,' for Joe?
